name: Cupendtonic
description: Coil qi into shoulder and spine, storing a spring of force to be whipped out through the board.

name: Cruel Whipover
description: Lash the board forward so its tip cracks like a whip and the dart leaves in a flat hiss.

name: Spurglide
description: Turn the spine away from a thrust as the throw finishes, letting the point pass the ribs.

name: Attentive Dartshaft
description: Listen to the hum of a dart in flight and judge how far it fell short or long.

name: Quickening Spurhook
description: Snap the next dart onto the spur with the backswing of the last, so no beat is lost.

name: Extendthwack
description: Whip three darts in quick succession from one rooted stance, each leaving with its own sharp crack.

name: Rigid Throwstick
description: Stiffen the board with qi and flick it across to turn a thrust away from the throat.

name: Alert Weightstone
description: Mark with qi-sense the empty air where the target will stand when the dart arrives.

name: Hearty Cupend
description: Thread a hair of qi through the spur seat so the dart clings until the instant of release.

name: Keen Overarm
description: Release at the bottom of an exhale, when the arm is steadiest, for a calm and level dart.

name: Rough Leverage
description: Cast across the path of a moving foe so the dart meets him as he steps.

name: Cuphasp
description: Turn the board side toward the foe while reloading, so arm and board cover the body.

name: Coasting Flexshaft
description: Match the pace of a walking target and keep the cast distance steady through several throws.

name: Spurswat
description: Throw well ahead of a sprinting foe, with qi bending the arc so the dart drops across his path.

name: Brisk Throwlever
description: Cast one dart at the foe and a second where he will dodge, reading his weight shift.

name: Sound Fingerhooks
description: Send a pulse of qi-sense along the dart's path and nudge the next cast onto the foe's true line.

name: Brawn Throwstick
description: Stretch the casting arm out and forward with qi in the fingertips, adding a hand's length to the throw.

name: Poisespur
description: Push off the rear leg with a pulse of qi, so the throw carries the weight of the whole body.

name: Gap Flexshaft
description: Keep a far mark steady in the eye by tracing its outline with a thread of qi-sense.

name: Comet Throwlever
description: Cast at a high angle with the arm fully extended, and the dart reaches a mark well beyond common range.

name: Brutal Overarm
description: Heave a heavy dart with full qi in the arm, and it falls with crushing weight on a distant target.

name: Spurswerve
description: Step through the end of a long cast to catch the body's balance and stand ready to throw again.

name: Sure Dartshaft
description: Weigh the long pinning dart in the hand to find the balance point where it flies straightest.

name: Spurcordial
description: Run a fingertip along the barb of the foreshaft to be sure it will hold fast once driven in.

name: Wild Gripbinding
description: Aim at the hem of a cloak or edge of a boot, where a dart can fasten a foe.

name: Lithe Handgrip
description: Advance in a crouch with the board low, shrinking the target while closing the gap.

name: Kindly Throwstick
description: Drop qi into the feet at the moment of release so the cast does not pull the thrower off line.

name: Genial Fingerhooks
description: Narrow the eyes on one thread of the foe's clothing and ignore all else in the scene.

name: Propelslap
description: Skip a dart off the ground so it comes up at knee height under a foe's guard.

name: Binding Spurhook
description: Drive a dart through the edge of a foe's boot into the earth, holding him in place for a moment.

name: Clutching Weightstone
description: Nail a loose sleeve to a post or beam, tearing the foe off balance as he pulls.

name: Grim Cupend
description: Step in and drive the board's butt into the jaw of a pinned foe before he frees himself.

name: Rallying Spurhook
description: Run with the loaded board tucked against the hip and a trickle of qi keeping the dart seated.

name: Staticspur
description: Let the dart go at the top of a stride, when both feet are off the ground and the body is still.

name: Hum Handgrip
description: Feel each footfall through the soles and choose the one beat when the arm will be steadiest.

name: Fleet Throwstick
description: Drag the lead foot to halt a run in one stride and stand rooted for the cast.

name: Grit Dartshaft
description: Dig the heel and spin around on it, throwing dust and turning the front to face a pursuer.

name: Fingerhooks Cordial
description: Feel with the thumb in mid-run that the dart is still firmly seated on the spur.

name: Ember Whipover
description: Cast again and again at every fourth stride of a run, each dart leaving as the thrower closes.

name: Propelswat
description: Twist at the waist while fleeing and cast backward over the shoulder at the nearest pursuer.

name: Lunar Gripbinding
description: Hold an arm's length and a half between neighbors on the line, so boards never collide.

name: Sprout Flexshaft
description: Wait one beat after the thrower on the left, so the casts roll along the line and never clump.

name: Rillcup
description: Step back in unison with the neighbors, keeping the interval while the whole line yields ground.

name: Candor Dartshaft
description: Name one mark aloud and fix on it, so the whole line casts at the same target.

name: Sturdy Spurhook
description: Raise the board's flat overhead to turn aside a falling dart while the neighbor reloads.

name: Extendscorer
description: Cast in rolling beats along the line, so darts fall on one mark in a long unbroken drumming.

name: Slinking Cupend
description: Slide sideways into a gap where a thrower has fallen, and take his place in the count.

name: Humcup
description: Count a slow beat in the head so every dart leaves the board on the same measured pulse.

name: Overarm Slap
description: Cast over the heads of comrades in front at a steeper angle, so no dart clips a friend.

name: Recall Spurhook
description: Reckon how many heartbeats a dart spends aloft at a given range and time the next cast by it.

name: Gleam Whipover
description: Release one heartbeat after the thrower beside you, so darts fall in a chain and not a clump.

name: Quickening Dartshaft
description: Reload on the off-beat in silence, keeping the arm ready for the next count without a wasted motion.

name: Propelcurl
description: Leave the count with one clean step when a foe closes, then rejoin the beat from a new spot.

name: Cupendslap
description: Vary the arc of each cast so darts thrown at different moments all fall on the mark together.

name: Weighty Throwlever
description: Cast counted darts at one patch of ground until foes dare not cross it.

name: Shard Propel
description: Cast one dart and draw the next within the same count, so the foe counts two throwers.

name: Purpose Handgrip
description: Carry the heavy hunting dart with qi in the forearm so its weight does not tire the throwing arm.

name: Gapspur
description: Watch a beast's gait for the hitch that shows where an earlier wound lies.

name: Harsh Throwstick
description: Aim at the line of the neck behind the jaw, where a dart finds soft hide.

name: Stalwart Handgrip
description: Plant the feet and breathe low as the beast closes, so fear does not spoil the cast.

name: Rill Gripbinding
description: Slip behind the nearest trunk as the beast charges, forcing it to turn.

name: Haze Dartshaft
description: Strike the board's edge against the side of a charging beast's head to veer its rush.

name: Bold Extend
description: Hold the cast until the beast opens its chest, then drive a heavy dart through with stored force.

name: Cupscorer
description: Throw at the hind leg of a fleeing beast to slow it, trailing it for the later killing cast.
